factory_causal_bullish_butterfly.hypothesis: A fixed bullish five-pivot Butterfly geometry, observed only after strict three-right-bar pivot confirmation and one lagged context bar, may identify a tradable overextension reversal after a separate closed bullish response. Shared ATR risk/cost rules remain fixed; this exploratory hypothesis claims no positive expectancy.

factory_efficiency_midpoint_reclaim.hypothesis: High lagged directional path efficiency may identify persistent auction pressure that survives a later closed pullback-and-reclaim of the prior range midpoint.

factory_efficiency_vwap_reclaim.hypothesis: A causally efficient completed trend may retain directional pressure when a later closed candle reclaims the session bar-volume price proxy after an intrabar dip.

factory_entropy_volcluster_break.hypothesis: A low-entropy directional path combined with lagged absolute-return persistence and independently observed lagged volume-to-absolute-return coupling may distinguish a 15-minute structural expansion in completed 4h up-market context from unconditional momentum. No hidden order book or trade-signed volume is inferred; historical results are non-pristine diagnostics only.

factory_isolated_downshock_recovery.hypothesis: A prior closed negative return unusually large relative to pre-event bipower-inspired volatility, with excess realized variation in a completed range regime, may precede an own-price recovery confirmed one bar later. This is a finite-grid shock proxy, not a significant-jump test, hidden liquidity signal or profitable edge.

factory_isolated_upshock_followthrough.hypothesis: A prior closed positive return unusually large relative to pre-event bipower-inspired volatility, with excess realized variation and completed positive higher-timeframe structure, may have continuation after a separate own-price confirmation. This is a finite-grid shock proxy, not a significant-jump test or profitable edge.

factory_negative_serial_range_rebound.hypothesis: Negative lagged short-horizon return dependence inside a completed range may favor a later closed downside-failure rebound rather than momentum continuation.

factory_peer_lead_beta_failure_reclaim.hypothesis: When the peer has statistically led the own asset in strictly completed history, a negative lagged beta residual followed by a closed own failed-low rejection in a completed 4h range may encode delayed response rather than an ordinary standalone mean-reversion entry. The lead relation and residual are historical estimates; no peer trade, executable spread, L2, or profitable edge is asserted.

factory_peer_residual_range_break.hypothesis: A lagged positive residual relative to peer beta may identify own-asset leadership that persists only after a later closed break of prior local resistance.

factory_peer_residual_vwap_reclaim.hypothesis: A lagged negative own return residual relative to a causally estimated peer beta may represent temporary under-response that resolves only after a later own-asset VWAP-proxy reclaim.

factory_peer_volatility_midpoint_catchup.hypothesis: A lagged own-versus-peer realized-volatility imbalance may identify a delayed own-asset catch-up only after a later closed midpoint reclaim in a non-trending higher-timeframe regime.

factory_relative_momentum_vwap_reclaim.hypothesis: Lagged own-minus-peer relative momentum above its historical baseline may persist only when the target asset later closes back above its session bar-volume price proxy.

factory_serial_prior_day_continuation.hypothesis: Positive lagged serial dependence combined with completed higher-timeframe strength may support continuation only after a later closed break of the fully completed prior UTC-day high.

factory_utc_slot_volume_breakout.hypothesis: Volume on the preceding closed bar exceeding its seven prior same-UTC-slot observations, with a stable seasonal baseline and completed higher-timeframe uptrend, may identify participation useful for a subsequent confirmed range breakout. This fixed exploratory hypothesis claims neither order flow nor a profitable edge.

factory_vov_midpoint_release.hypothesis: An unusually stable lagged low volatility-of-volatility state may identify compression that releases only after a later closed reclaim of the prior range midpoint with volume expansion.

factory_vov_prior_day_release.hypothesis: A stable lagged volatility-of-volatility compression may resolve directionally only when a later closed candle clears the fully completed prior UTC-day high with strong relative volume.

factory_wick_trend_reentry.hypothesis: Elevated lagged lower-wick rejection relative to its own baseline may indicate persistent dip absorption before a later closed re-entry above prior local resistance in an up regime.

factory_wick_vwap_reclaim.hypothesis: Repeated lagged lower-wick rejection inside a completed range may precede a later closed reclaim of the session bar-volume price proxy without assuming hidden order-book absorption.
